# BoosterTea - Premium Ukrainian Tea Concentrates
> Ready drink in 15 seconds. No brewing, no waiting, no compromise on taste.

## About BoosterTea

BoosterTea is a Ukrainian premium tea concentrates brand based in Lviv, Ukraine. We produce high-quality tea concentrates from authentic Chinese teas that can be prepared in just 15 seconds - simply add hot water.

Our mission is to make premium Chinese tea accessible to everyone, whether you're at home, in a café, or on the go. Each bottle contains 40+ portions of tea made from carefully selected leaves.

## How It Works

1. **Heat water** to 85-95°C
2. **Add 25ml** of tea concentrate to your cup
3. **Pour hot water** and stir
4. **Enjoy** premium Chinese tea in 15 seconds

## FAQ

**Q: How long does a bottle last?**
A: One 1L bottle provides 40+ portions when used as directed (25ml per serving).

**Q: Do I need any special equipment?**
A: No, just hot water and a cup.

**Q: Is it real tea?**
A: Yes! We use authentic Chinese tea leaves processed into concentrated form while preserving all the beneficial compounds.

**Q: How should I store it?**
A: Keep refrigerated after opening. Unopened bottles can be stored at room temperature.

**Q: Do you ship internationally?**
A: Currently we deliver only within Ukraine. International shipping coming soon.
